'''Danu 12 (December 5)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - An unexpected thaw melts all of the snow on [[Dragonmount]], except on the very peak. 
*{{ne|999}} - [[Loial]] arrives in [[Caemlyn]]. Seven of the [[Salidar]] embassy go to the palace in an attempt to intimidate [[Rand]]. [[Kiruna]] and [[Bera]] arrive and take control of the Salidar embassy, bringing the number of [[Aes Sedai]] to thirteen. Rand takes [[Min]], [[Perrin]] and [[Faile]] to [[Cairhien]]. 
*{{ne|999}} - Rand takes to his bed. [[Coiren]] sends a note asking to meet Rand; he declines. [[Berelain]] begins flirting with Perrin.
